answer: An operator copying one text across 116 aliases therefore forfeits for 116 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. Since the dune hash is stored at intake, the wander graph groups the endorsements and the oasis audit shows the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 4 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
